system.description:
Warrior Setites are most likely to learn this combination power, taking the form of the mysterious Typhonic animal associated with Set. The transformed vampire gains a dot each of Strength, Dexterity and Stamina plus the benefits of Potence; the soak difficulty from Skin of the Adder applies (dropping to 5), letting her soak aggravated damage from claws and fangs (but not fire, sunlight or magic); she also gains the venomous bite of Form of the Cobra, doubles her running speed and gains a bonus on Perception rolls related to smell or hearing. The vampire remains in bestial form until the next sunrise or until she voluntarily changes back; clothing and small personal items transform along with her.

You spend three Blood Traits. You gain the Trait and damage bonuses of Skin of the Adder, plus the negative Social Traits it carries, a venomous bite, the Mental Trait Observant x2, and three added Physical Traits. This power costs 11 Experience Traits to learn.
system.source: Clanbook: Followers of Set, Chapter Two
system.duration: Until next sunrise or the vampire reverts
system.prerequisites: Potence, Serpentis (Skin of the Adder, Form of the Cobra)
